models.use: Other road users' cars (moving-off purple car, zebra following car, Brentwood lead car); body tinted per road user
modifications: Converted OBJ+MTL to GLB with obj2gltf 3.2.0
glTF-Transform 4.5.1: weld, dedup, join (one primitive per material), prune, quantize (KHR_mesh_quantization)

At load: glTF PBR materials replaced with StandardMaterial of the same colour (cheaper on phones, lit like the rest of the scene); body material 'Blue' recoloured per road user; turned 180° and scaled uniformly to the 4.3 m collision length

models.use: Moving off safely: house on the west side (replaces the simple block house-w-1; its collision box is kept)
modifications: Lowest detail level, uncompressed copy (no meshopt decoder needed)
glTF-Transform 4.5.1: weld, dedup, join, prune, quantize (KHR_mesh_quantization)
At load: PBR materials replaced with StandardMaterial of the same colours and textures

models.use: Brentwood: one signal pole on the learner's near side before the High Street signal crossing. Lamps are fixed as modelled (green lit); signals are not simulated
modifications: FBX converted to glTF with FBX2glTF 0.9.7
Only the 'Traffic Lights' object kept, centred, base at ground level (tools/assets/extract-object.mjs)
glTF-Transform 4.5.1: weld, dedup, join, prune, quantize
At load: PBR materials replaced with StandardMaterial of the same colours (emissive kept)

models.use: Moving off safely: supermarket on the east side, shopfront facing the road (replaces the simple block house-e-1; its collision box is kept)
modifications: glTF-Transform 4.5.1: weld, dedup, join, prune, quantize
At load: PBR materials replaced with StandardMaterial of the same colours

models.use: Moving off safely: taller brick building on the east side, behind the supermarket (replaces the simple block house-e-2; its collision box is kept)
modifications: Upstream (by the supplier's preparation): glTF + BIN + PNG packed into GLB; textures downsampled from 2048/1024 px to 512 px
Normal, occlusion and metal/roughness maps removed (not used by the simulator's StandardMaterial path); uniformly white vertex colours removed
Base colour maps re-encoded as JPEG (quality 82): 512 px; window interiors, marble floor and asphalt 256 px (tools/assets/slim-textures.mjs)
glTF-Transform 4.5.1: weld, dedup (identical materials merged), join, prune, quantize. No decimation; geometry, pivot and node transform otherwise unchanged
At load: PBR materials replaced with StandardMaterial of the same colours and textures
models.build: TOOLS=<scratch folder> tools/assets/build-downtown.sh <extracted Downtown_City_UK_Starter folder> Building_Small_1
